blackHair.name: Black Hair
blackHair.description: Found at crime scene. Can help narrow down suspects.

metadata.useMessage: I'm not putting that on my head. My hairline has enough problems.

mudFootprint.name: Mud Footprint (Size 10)
mudFootprint.description: Distinctive boot print. Size 10, work boots.

metadata.useMessage: I resist stepping in it. One mysterious footprint is quite enough.

fabricFiber.name: Fabric Fiber
fabricFiber.description: Black wool fiber. Could match clothing.

metadata.useMessage: Not enough for a sweater. Too much for my sandwich.

goldEarring.name: Gold Earring
goldEarring.description: Fragment of jewelry. Could belong to suspect.

metadata.useMessage: Tempting, but 'accessorising with evidence' isn't covered by the dress code.
I'll avoid adding my own fingerprint. This one already has commitment issues.

coin.name: Antique Coin
coin.description: Old currency. Could be red herring.

metadata.useMessage: The vending machine would reject it. We have that in common.

necklaceFragment.name: Necklace Fragment
necklaceFragment.description: Broken jewelry piece. May indicate struggle.

metadata.useMessage: Too short for a necklace. Too important for a craft project.
A lockpick needs a lock. Otherwise I'm just threatening the air.
I'll leave it bagged. Undercover work shouldn't start with contaminating the evidence.
I consider a dramatic rope entrance. My knees request a second opinion.

jemmyBar.name: Crowbar
jemmyBar.description: Tool for forcing locks and doors.

metadata.useMessage: The universal key. Universally unpopular with door owners.
Finally, a bright idea I can hold.
I could open a locksmith business. The invoices would be less emotionally complicated.
A master key. Still needs a door. Leadership has its limits.
Access to the office. Sadly, not access to a higher salary.
I turn it in the air. The air remains unlocked.
I practise looking like someone who knows where they parked.

planeTicket.name: Plane Ticket
planeTicket.description: Paris to Cairo. Departure date: Tomorrow.

metadata.useMessage: Waving this around won't make a plane arrive. I've tried less sensible things.
I check the numbers. Still not my money. A consistent disappointment.

letterFromWife.name: Letter from Wife
letterFromWife.description: Threatening letter. "You'll pay for what you did."

metadata.useMessage: I consider replying 'unsubscribe'. Probably not legally binding.

agencyMissionReport.name: Mission Report
agencyMissionReport.description: A completed Mark Agency mission report. Submit it to Lieutenant Frank Drebin in the archive.

metadata.useMessage: This needs to go to Drebin in the archive. Apparently filing it in my pocket doesn't count.
I study the photograph. Saying 'enhance' achieves absolutely nothing.
A certificate of authenticity. I wonder who certifies the certificate.

hotelReservation.name: Hotel Reservation
hotelReservation.description: Booking in Vienna under false name.

metadata.useMessage: I consider room service. Then I remember whose reservation this is.
I hold it authoritatively. Sadly, doors prefer an actual card reader.

agencyFieldManual.name: Agency Field Manual
agencyFieldManual.description: The official Mark Agency Field Manual. Covers evidence, travel, paperwork, and other occupational hazards. Also recommended for stabilising wobbly desks.

metadata.useMessage: Evidence handling. Travel procedures. Expense claims. Somehow, the chapter on surviving paperwork is the longest.

detectiveMonthly.name: Detective Monthly
detectiveMonthly.description: The magazine for private investigators. This month: 'Is Your Alibi Working Hard Enough?' and twelve coats you cannot afford.

metadata.useMessage: I turn to 'Ten Signs You Are Being Followed'. Someone has already bookmarked it.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.description: Strong coffee. Your sleep schedule has already filed a complaint.

metadata.useMessage: That's better. My hands have stopped negotiating with each other.

energyDrink.name: Energy Drink
energyDrink.description: Neon liquid with a warning label longer than your case file. Wings not included.

metadata.useMessage: I can taste the warning label. I think I can hear it, too.

sandwich.name: Sandwich
sandwich.description: Two slices of bread, one slice of hope. Classic detective dinner.

metadata.useMessage: Lunch. I'll keep the mayonnaise away from the witness statements.

mysteryPie.name: Mystery Meat Pie
mysteryPie.description: Sold from a van that left immediately. Nobody knows what's inside, including the pie.

metadata.useMessage: Delicious. I withdraw all further questions about the ingredients.

postcard.name: Postcard
postcard.description: Wish you were here. Preferably with an alibi.

metadata.useMessage: Dear everyone: the weather is lovely, the suspects less so.

snowGlobe.name: Souvenir Snow Globe
snowGlobe.description: A tiny landmark in a snowstorm. Possibly from this city. Possibly from a catalogue.

metadata.useMessage: I give it a little shake. At least one city is having a worse day than mine.

parisTower.name: Tiny Iron Tower
parisTower.description: Mini lattice tower. Made somewhere that is definitely not Paris.

metadata.useMessage: I hold it at arm's length. Budget sightseeing.

londonGuardHat.name: Tiny Guard Hat
londonGuardHat.description: Fuzzy hat, no guard inside. Stands perfectly still on your desk, just like the real ones.

metadata.useMessage: Too small for my head. Too formal for my thumb.

berlinWallChunk.name: Wall Chunk (Certified*)
berlinWallChunk.description: *Certified by a guy named Dieter. Suspiciously similar to a garden brick.

metadata.useMessage: I contemplate building something. At this rate, a house will cost several million souvenirs.

nycFoamCrown.name: Foam Liberty Crown
nycFoamCrown.description: Makes you 4% more tourist and 100% easier to tail.

metadata.useMessage: I try it on. Liberty has never looked so underpaid.

warsawMermaid.name: Mermaid Magnet
warsawMermaid.description: She holds a sword and a shield. Your fridge is now safer than your office.

metadata.useMessage: I could deputise her. She brought more equipment than I did.

delhiSpiceSachet.name: Spice Sachet
delhiSpiceSachet.description: Smells like an entire market. Your evidence bags will never forget it.

metadata.useMessage: I'll keep it sealed. The case has enough heat without seasoning the evidence.

kottoElephant.name: Tiny Wooden Elephant
kottoElephant.description: Hand-carved. Trunk up for luck, which your case file badly needs.

metadata.useMessage: I ask it for luck. It maintains a professional silence.

torontoMaple.name: Maple Syrup Shot
torontoMaple.description: Sweet, sticky, and extremely sorry about it.

metadata.useMessage: I'll keep the seal intact. My pockets are not equipped for a syrup incident.

nairobiGiraffe.name: Carved Giraffe
nairobiGiraffe.description: Tall, silent, sees everything. Excellent witness, terrible at giving statements.

metadata.useMessage: I ask it to keep an eye out. It has a considerable advantage.

islamabadTruck.name: Truck Art Keychain
islamabadTruck.description: Painted brighter than your entire case file. Horn not included.

metadata.useMessage: I make a tiny truck noise. Strictly for investigative purposes.

tokyoLuckyCat.name: Lucky Cat
tokyoLuckyCat.description: Waves at you nonstop. Silently judges your finances.

metadata.useMessage: I wave back. Finally, a friendly exchange with no follow-up questions.

inflatableAlibi.name: Inflatable Alibi
inflatableAlibi.description: Looks like a person from a distance. Do not use near cacti.

metadata.useMessage: I consider inflating my alibi. It already has more holes than I'd like.

rubberDuck.name: Rubber Duck
rubberDuck.description: Waterproof. Unflappable. Has never cracked under questioning.

metadata.useMessage: Squeak. Finally, a witness with a consistent story.
I check my notes. Past me was very optimistic about future me understanding these.
I show the photo to myself. Yes, officer, I have seen this person. In this photo.
I admire the card. It would be more useful with a telephone involved.
I polish it with a look. Actual polishing sounds like work.
I rotate the map. Now I'm lost in a different direction.
I'll save the supplies for an actual investigation task. Opening the kit dramatically isn't one.

piBadge.name: PI Badge
piBadge.description: A private investigator badge. Looks official. Does not make you the police.

metadata.useMessage: Private investigator. Very private. Extremely investigator. Still not the police.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: A compact camera. Captures evidence, awkward moments, and your thumb.

metadata.useMessage: A camera needs a subject. My shoes have declined to comment.

mobilePhone.name: Mobile Phone
mobilePhone.description: A mobile phone. For calls that cannot wait until you get back to the office.

metadata.useMessage: I'll need a number and a reason to call. Heavy breathing isn't a business model.

coolSpyGadget.name: Cool Spy Gadget
coolSpyGadget.description: A very impressive device with several blinking lights. The manual refers to its function as classified.

metadata.useMessage: I press the impressive-looking button. A light blinks. I feel briefly qualified.
